schema_note: 2026-11-01: minified keys retired per the master directory backend mapping. Served records now use full names EXACTLY: id, name, city, state, website, phone, email (always null publicly), description, amenities, latitude, longitude, slug, featured_tier ('featured'|'none'), address (or null), pricing {day_pass, hot_desk_monthly, dedicated_desk_monthly, private_office_monthly, meeting_room_hourly, source} (or null), hours, membership_tiers, event_space, events, programs, services. Dropped: ct, claimed, street (folded into address), currency/updated_at (provenance stays in brand_pricing). The pipeline maps via to_internal/to_public; to_internal accepts both shapes for idempotent re-runs.

brands_researched.notes: Day pass $39 and hot desk ~$350/mo (Bellevue, nucamp 2026); private office past $1,000/person/mo in major markets (alliancevirtualoffices 2026). Location-specific rates vary; dedicated-desk pricing not published online.

Day pass ~$49, 30-day access plan ~$330/mo (Montreal, 2727 Coworking 2026); desk memberships $300-400/mo and small private offices from ~$600/mo (Bellevue, nucamp 2026). Flat monthly hot-desk rate not published.
Spaces (IWG) prices per-day, not monthly: dedicated desks from ~$8/person/day, individual offices ~$11/person/day (Montreal, spacesworks.com 2026). No flat monthly rate published; pricing null.
Thin US published data; figures from workin.space aggregator for HQ Triadelphia WV: day pass $45, coworking from $309/mo, private office from $650/mo.
Coworking from $399/mo, day passes $60-68, private offices from ~$1,100/mo (DC/Durham/Charlotte, nucamp 2026); community memberships $419-918/mo by market (alliancevirtualoffices 2026).

Brand site (officeevolution.com): Day Pass from $30/day, Coworking Plan from $99/mo, Dedicated Desks from $400/mo, Dedicated Offices from $500/mo, Meeting Rooms from $30/hr. Rates vary by franchise location.
Venture X blog: memberships from $99/mo, day passes from $25/day. Location pages: dedicated desks from $349 (Orlando), private offices from $865 (Atlanta Cumberland). Varies by franchise.

Unlimited coworking monthly pass from $179 (Atlanta Buckhead, liquidspace); dedicated desks from $249/desk/mo, private offices from $529/office/mo (serendipitylabs.com Alpharetta). Day offices $59/day (Buckhead) - not a coworking day pass.

expansive.com: coworking from $149/mo (up to $199 some locations). Listings: day pass from $33, dedicated desks from $250 (Wauwatosa), private offices from $527 (Wauwatosa), meeting rooms from $40/hr (Charlotte). Wide market variance.
LiquidSpace listings: Coworking Home Base from $249/mo, Dedicated desk $550/mo, 1-person executive office from $1,800/mo (Chevy Chase). Private offices vary widely by market.
Columbus Circle listing: day pass from $30, coworking membership from $425/mo, meeting room from $48/hr. Gowanus (liquidspace): dedicated desk $420/mo, 1-person private office from $650/mo.

kiln.com: Club (shared desk) from $275/mo (Daybreak standard rate; founding $99/mo is promotional), Resident dedicated desk from $525/mo (Holladay), private offices from $1,200/mo (Holladay). Rates vary widely by location; day passes sold per location.
Convene publishes no public membership pricing; meeting/event rates quoted on request. Pricing null.
bondcollective.com Market Street: day passes from $35/day, coworking from $300/mo, dedicated desks from $500/mo, private offices from $700/mo, conference rooms from $50-55/hr.
workbar.com: Unlimited $349-499/mo, Dedicated Desk $499-699/mo, Private Office starting $399/desk/mo; Hybrid part-time plan $199-279/mo. Boston-area network; day passes not published.
Day passes from $50, monthly coworking from ~$199 (Fort Lauderdale, nucamp 2026); meeting rooms from $75/hr (Doral, commercialsearch). Florida-focused network.
Pittsburgh rate card: coworking from $179/mo, dedicated desks from $299/mo, private offices (1-2 person) from $629/mo. Advertises under WeWork/Regus pricing.
Carlsbad HQ (liquidspace): Communal $250/mo, Dedicated desk $475/mo; private offices from $800/mo (commercialsearch). Enterprise-focused network.

Women-focused licensing network; pricing varies by location. Chicago: coworking membership $199/mo. DC (Oct 2026 pricing PDF): membership $99-149/mo + workspace add-ons; non-member meeting room $35/hr. Membership + add-on model.

mindspace.me: day pass from $42 (SF) / $60 (Miami/NYC), coworking from $229/mo (Miami), meeting rooms from $60/hr (Miami). Dedicated desk $450 (DC K St, liquidspace); private office from $770 (DC, devx). Wide market variance.
